name: UU Congregation of the Swannanoa Valley

reviews.t: We support UUCSV because of its strong presence in this community. Wherever we go in Black Mountain and the surrounding area we run into active members of this congregation who are busy making things better for the community and doing things we like to do. We feel at home here."

UUCSV is a sincere welcoming congregation with outstanding, diverse music and an overall Sunday service that fosters and promotes hope in today's environment. The minister's sermons are interesting, encouraging and beautifully prepared. Giving an hour of your time to explore this unique spiritual experience is well worth it. We visited for the first time five years ago and became active members. UUCSV is a meaningful and transformative spirtual home for us.

I've been participating in this church community since my daughter sat like a weeble wobble and my toddler son raced around. They are now grown adults. This place is home to me. I feel like I'm being embraced by family love when I cross the threshold of UUCSV. I am known here and held accountable for leading my life the best way I can. The services touch my heart and challenge my perspective. I am a better person for this place. Please join us!

Having recently moved to the area, I was looking for a spiritual community, and this congregation has truly stood out.It is remarkably inclusive, supportive and welcoming. The environment is warm, the people are genuinely kind, and there is a strong commitment to serving the broader community. I've really appreciated finding a place that feels both open hearted and grounded..

The first time I attended a service at UUCSV, I said to Rev. Michael Carter; I fly to go hear teachers like you. I immediately became an active member of the Congregation, and it's now an important part of my life. Michael is intelligent, deep, well-read, informed, and genuine. Music Director Annelinde Metzner is gifted and connected. The membership of UUCSV is welcoming, diverse, open-minded, and loving. In every aspect, this is a wonderful Community.

We became members this year and highly recommend UUCSV in Black Mountain. We share the same values as this congregation where ALL are welcome and treated with respect and dignity. Reverend Carter's sermons are always inspiring, insightful and on point with the current and challenging times we live in. We highly recommend this church.

Each service at UUSV feels like a thoughtful invitation into something deeper. Whether it’s the special musical performances, reverent poetry, or quiet moments of meditation, there’s always a sense of intention and creativity. For me, this is a space that truly nurtures the spirit and opens the heart. What stands out most is how love is genuinely at the center here — love for each other, for the earth, and for justice. I've found a spiritual home at UUSV and feel deeply supported by this community of wholehearted people. If you're looking for a place that blends spirituality with beauty, meaning, and care for the world, this is it.

This small church is just right for me. I don't feel like just a number here. Pastor Mike is very cool, hip, and informed. He has a vast knowledge of a lot of things, and presents them in an engaging manner. He always makes the congregation laugh, which just makes us all knit together in one cohesive voice.
This is a wonderful, friendly, open, nonjudgmental congregation with a fabulous minister in Rev. Michael Carter. All are welcome, many people who visit become members. Highly recommended.
UU is about as close as you can get as a community gathering place that celebrates life and justice and Spirit. Sadly white bread though, diversity is scarce.
